paper_metadata.title: Area-Efficient Linear Regulator With Ultra-Fast Load Regulation
paper_metadata.abstract: We demonstrate a fully integrated linear regulator for multisupply voltage microprocessors implemented in a 90 nm Therefore, a fully integrated linear regulator with no external CMOS technology. Ultra-fast single-stage load regulation achieves components is attractive for applications with stringent volume a 0.54-ns response time at 94% current efficiency. For a 1.2-V 90 mVP-P output droop for a 100-mA load step with only a small and weight requirements and relatively small peak power of input voltage and 0.9-V output voltage the regulator enables a 1 W. on-chip decoupling capacitor of 0.6 nF. By using a PMOS pull-up We demonstrate a linear regulator implemented in a 90-nm transistor in the output stage we achieved a small regulator area CMOS technology that converts from 1.2 to 0.9 V with 94% of 0.008 mm2 and a minimum dropout voltage of 0.2 V for 100 mA current efficiency. The regulator occupies an area of 0.008 mm of output current. The area for the 0.6-nF MOS capacitor is 0.090 mm2. for a 100-mA rating.
